## 📝 Description
## 🛠️ Type of Change
- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] ✨ New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] 💥 Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] 📖 Documentation update (changes to the /docs folder or root .md files)
- [ ] 🎨 Style/Refactor (formatting, local variables, no functional changes)

## 🧪 How Has This Been Tested?
- [ ] **Manual Test:** (Describe steps)
- [ ] **Automated Test:** (List new or existing tests passed)

## 📚 Documentation Checklist
Since Git-Toolkit prioritizes clear documentation, please confirm:
- [ ] I have updated the **`README.md`** (if applicable).
- [ ] I have updated the relevant files in **`docs/en/`** (e.g., `Technical Specifications.md` or `How-To Guide.md`).
- [ ] If adding a new tool, I have updated **`docs/tools/i18n/README.md`**.
- [ ] I have checked **`branch-naming-guidelines.md`** for compliance.

## 🏁 Checklist:
- [ ] My code follows the style guidelines of this project.
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my own code.
- [ ] I have commented my code, particularly in hard-to-understand areas.
- [ ] My changes generate no new warnings.
- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works.

## 📸 Screenshots / Demos
